title: Product Bundle Photos for Clearer Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every item in your kit in one square bundle photo. Use it on Amazon, Shopify, gift pages, social ads, and posts without booking another photo shoot.
h1: Product Bundle Photos That Show Every Shipped Piece
lead: Product bundle photos let a shopper count every piece in the square. Upload the full coffee kit you ship, and the layout keeps the bag, the grinder, and the mug in view.
steps_h2: How to Make a Bundle Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You get one square a shopper can count, from one photo of the coffee kit. Add a script if you also want a short kit video.

steps.d: Upload the coffee bag, the grinder, and the mug together. Each piece that ships should sit inside the frame.
Ask for the full coffee kit on a wood table. The bag, the grinder, and the mug all stay visible in the square.
Download the coffee-kit square with every piece visible. A kit video can add a script and an AI voice.

faq.q: What does a product bundle photo template include?
faq.a: It is a square layout for the set you ship. Put every piece in one photo and download that square. You can add an AI actor, a voiceover, and a script when the kit also needs a video.

faq.q: How does the bundle photo come together?
faq.a: One photo of the full set is the input. The layout keeps each piece visible, then you download the square. Several kits can go through the API when the folder is large, and you still check the first file yourself.

faq.q: Why use a bundle template instead of a new shoot?
faq.a: The kit photo you already took is the one to use. You skip renting lights and booking a creator, and you still get a square for the listing or the ad.

faq.q: Who should use a kit layout?
faq.a: Shops, gift brands, and agencies that need a contents view for a listing, a bundle page, or an ad. One set is enough to start, and a larger catalog can follow.

faq.q: Can I do this on a first try?
faq.a: Yes, when every piece is already in the photo. Follow the three steps. If you also make a video, set a song and an AI voice in the editor before you download.

faq.q: Which kinds of kits fit this layout?
faq.a: Any set you ship as one unit works here: skincare kits, gift sets, food bundles, and home kits. Single clothing items and loose gadgets live in the wider library. Open another category when the set should change.

faq.q: What should I upload for the kit?
faq.a: A JPG, PNG, or WebP of the complete kit, or a short clip you have the rights to use. Include the box and the paper insert when they ship with the order. Leave every piece inside the frame.

faq.q: Where can I publish the kit file?
faq.a: The photo is square, which fits a product gallery. A video of the same kit can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Use the tall file for a TikTok placement and the square file on the product page or in a feed.

faq.q: What does a bundle photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the number before it starts, and a failed job returns those credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The file has no watermark, and a client delivery can use the same kit square in ads and on the product page.

faq.q: Why a kit template instead of an empty frame?
faq.a: The arrangement of the pieces is already in the layout. Your time goes to checking the coffee bag, the grinder, and the mug against the contents list, then posting.

steps.sourceHint: Include the coffee bag, grinder, mug and every piece that ships with the kit.
steps.prompt: The full coffee kit on a wood table, with every piece you ship left visible.
